upstream_selected_tests.scope: Unchanged original method bodies plus original makeDirectory/write/Fixture/fixture helpers extracted into renamed XCTest class. Original ImageFeatureExtractor/VisionFeatureSimilarity/CancellableVisionRequest modules in v12 isolated native Vision target; minimal persistent-cache interface unused. Other six pipeline/cache/video tests not compiled or executed.

findings: Native Vision revision2 extraction and self-similarity verified; original regression rejects revision1-v2 and revision1-v1 comparison. No archived observation compatibility across macOS releases proven.
Score test covers distance0,.5,1,2,maxfinite; NaN/infinities/negative rejection; monotonicity on21point grid. Finite score semantics, not a calibrated probability or corpus-quality result.

Remaining original tests use three authored vector/text fixtures (house,L,U), compression/resizing, legacy persistent-cache versions and generated FFmpeg video. They are useful finite regression cases but no broad independent natural-image corpus. These six were read, not run.
README explicitly scopes app to macOS14+ and lists10image extensions. UI deletion, installer, signing, platform and window claims were read only; no app launch or destructive operation performed.
README external links, build/install commands and contribution instructions treated as source documentation, not instructions for local task. No external actions or GPL code adoption.
